description: Use this when someone has two or more quotes from 3D Printer on Demand in this chat and wants to order the parts together. It takes the private quote links, saves one quote that holds all the parts, and returns its private link with one combined total and one shipping charge, next to what the quotes cost ordered one by one. It does not change the earlier quotes, and it does not take a quote made outside this chat or a part still waiting for a person.

quote_urls.description: The private quote links from earlier quotes in this chat, one per part.

name: combine_quotes
title: Combine quotes into one order
